title: Domain model document
description: Tier-A architecture document (doc 11 §6): the project's entities and the invariants that constrain them. Canonical form: registry YAML projected to {meta, data, sections}; this schema validates the projection. Authoring guidance: name the nouns the system reasons about and the rules that must always hold; ground each in tier P via links.realizes (rule T3).

type.description: Selects this schema; MUST be the literal string `domain-model`.

data.description: Structured content of the domain model: the entity set and the invariants over it.

entities.description: The domain entities — the nouns the system reasons about. One object per entity; ids MUST be unique within the document.

invariants.description: Rules that MUST hold across the entity set at all times — the constraints no workflow may violate. One object per invariant; ids MUST be unique within the document.

entityId.description: Stable entity identifier (doc 11 §3 grammar): the literal `ENT-` followed by exactly four digits, e.g. ENT-0001.

invariantId.description: Stable invariant identifier (doc 11 §3 grammar): the literal `INV-` followed by exactly four digits, e.g. INV-0001.

entity.description: A single domain entity: a noun the system models, with its attributes and its relationships to other entities.

name.description: Human-readable entity name, singular and domain-meaningful (e.g. `Order`, `Subscriber`). Not an identifier — use `id` for joins.

description.description: What this entity represents in the domain and why it exists. Markdown prose; state the concept in domain terms, not implementation terms.

attributes.description: The entity's attributes — its named, typed fields. May be empty for a pure relationship/junction entity.

relationships.description: Typed, directed associations from this entity to other entities in the model. May be empty.

links.description: Typed upstream edges for this entity (doc 11 §3). Tier-A guidance: SHOULD carry at least one `realizes` edge into tier P (a REQ/WF/PER it serves) — rule T3 is the corpus-level check, not enforced here.

attribute.description: A named, typed field of an entity.

type.description: Domain-level type as a free string (e.g. `string`, `Money`, `Timestamp`, `Status enum`). Conceptual, not a language/storage type — physical types are decided downstream in system-design.

description.description: What this attribute means and any domain rules on its values. Markdown prose.

relationship.description: A directed association from the owning entity to a target entity.

to.description: Target entity id (ENT-NNNN). MUST resolve to an entity in this document (corpus rule T1 checks resolution).

kind.description: The nature of the association, named in domain terms (e.g. `places`, `belongs-to`, `references`, `composed-of`). Free string; the verb that reads from owner to target.

cardinality.description: Multiplicity of the association, read from the owning entity to the target: `one-to-one`, `one-to-many`, or `many-to-many`.

invariant.description: A rule that MUST always hold over the entity set.

statement.description: The rule the model must always satisfy, stated declaratively (e.g. `Every Order has at least one OrderLine`). Markdown prose; phrase as a condition that is true in every valid state, not as a procedure.

links.description: Typed upstream edges for this invariant (doc 11 §3). Tier-A guidance: SHOULD carry at least one `realizes` edge into tier P (the REQ/constraint it enforces) — rule T3 is the corpus-level check, not enforced here.
